## Activity

During February 2019, River Outreach operated its scheduled outreach sessions. The clinic team completed 56 captures during the reporting period. Session lists ran as planned apart from routine leave, and no disruption to the planned activity was recorded. The completed work provides the basis for the image-quality and grading review described below.

## Image quality

Graders reviewed the captured images and marked 7 sets ungradable. The ungradable rate was 12.5 of captures. These images could not be used for a reliable grading outcome and should be considered when reviewing session performance and any follow-up requirements. The result indicates that image acquisition remains an important operational consideration for the service at River Outreach.

## Grading

A total of 4 results were graded referable. The median grading wait was 0. This indicates that the reported results were processed without a delay at the median point. Overall, the February 2019 activity shows that River Outreach maintained planned session delivery, while image quality accounted for the principal limitation in the completed captures. The findings should inform routine monitoring of capture quality and grading workflow.
